'''Mike Eustice''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Livingston tournament]] on 27 October 2001 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH Twix pile M&T]], according to Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3079">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-livingston-nj-10-27-01d3079/ livingston-nj-10-27-01], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 28 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-livingston-nj-10-27-01d3079/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
